items: Chaar carbon atoms tak wale alkanes be-rang (colourless), be-boo (odourless) gases hain, jabke pentane se heptadecane (C₅ se C₁₇) tak be-rang, be-boo liquids hain. C₁₈ aur us se aage wale bare members mom jaise (waxy) solids hain, yeh bhi be-rang aur be-boo hain.
Alkanes non-polar ya bohat kam polar hain. Is liye yeh pani jaise polar solvents mein nahi hal hote, magar hexane, benzene, ether jaise non-polar solvents mein hal ho jate hain.

In ke physical constants, maslan boiling point, melting point aur density, carbon atoms barhne ke saath barhte hain, jabke solubility (hal hone ki salahiyat) molecular mass barhne ke saath kam hoti hai. Branched chain wale alkanes ka boiling point apne isomer (wahi formula) seedhi chain wale alkane se kam hota hai. Maslan seedhi chain wali butane ka boiling point −0.50 °C hai, jo 2-methylpropane (isobutane, −11.7 °C) se zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: Branched alkanes ke boiling points seedhi chain wale alkanes se kam kyun hote hain (Quick Check 11.2a)?
blocks.explanation: Alkane molecules sirf kamzor intermolecular forces (molecules ke darmiyan kashish) se jure hote hain, aur yeh is par depend karti hain ke molecules aik doosre ko kitni satah se chhoo sakte hain. Seedhi chain apni poori lambai mein saath wale molecules se lag sakti hai. Branched isomer zyada gol aur chhota (compact) hota hai, kam satah chhoota hai, is liye forces kamzor hoti hain aur use ubalne ke liye kam energy chahiye.

items: C₁–C₄ gases, C₅–C₁₇ liquids, C₁₈+ waxy solids; non-polar, pani mein hal nahi hote; boiling point, melting point aur density carbon ke saath barhte hain; branching boiling point kam karti hai (butane −0.5 °C, isobutane −11.7 °C).
